subject: Exec brief: slate synchronization, presenter owners, and "kicker" pre-reads
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Exec brief: slate synchronization, presenter owners, and "kicker" pre-reads

Team —

We have Granite Systems onsite on Nov 17 for a half-day exec briefing (0900–1300 PT). Goals: align leadership on deployment timeline, confirm SLOs, and surface any open security/compliance asks before the dedicated rollout.

Requests / asks:
- Can each of you confirm slot ownership in the attached slate by EOD 11/04? I tried to keep slides short (8–10 mins per owner).
- We need a "kicker" 5-min customer story or ROI datapoint after the Q&A — volunteer?
- Pre-reads: I assembled a 2-pager summary (attached). Please review and flag anything that must be elevated to the exec deck.
- Travel lanes: we need arrival windows for the client team (flight ETA) and a speaker arrival plan — Neha, can you coordinate hotel and airport logistics?

I dropped an updated deck (v3) into the Drive link below. I will consolidate and send the run-of-show on Friday.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Sr. Sales Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference

Cc: Karen Smith <karen.smith@granite.com>
Date: 2026-11-03T11:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Exec brief: slate synchronization, presenter owners, and "kicker" pre-reads

Alex —

Thanks for the slate. Quick notes after a pass:
- I can own the Deployment timeline slot (0900–0915) and the SLOs section (0930–0945). I propose moving the architecture deep-dive to an appendix to keep the main run clean.
- Vanessa: can you cover the Cost/Unit economics piece? I think that should be right after SLOs.
- Kicker: I can pull a short customer quote, but I'd prefer a product-led datapoint. If nobody objects I will draft a 3-slide micro-case (2 metrics + 1 quote).
- AV note: request for a wired laptop HDMI adapter and local clicker.

I'll attach a presenter matrix in Drive tonight — will include slide owner, backup, and required assets.

Irene

Alex
